data.long_meaning: The name Erlewine is derived from the Old German words 'eril' meaning 'earl' and 'wini' meaning 'friend'. It is a name of noble origin, suggesting strength, leadership, and companionship. The name Erlewine carries the meaning “Earl's friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erlewine usually hope their child will grow to embody earl's friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
